results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a kettlebell on your hips.
Plant one foot flat and lift the other leg.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Lower and repeat, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your hips square.
Hold the bell steady with both hands.
results.description: Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Quadriceps.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Romanian Deadlifts
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in the opposite hand.
Hinge at your hips and extend your free leg straight behind you.
Lower the bell toward the floor with a flat back.
Return to standing by driving your hips forward, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your hips square to the floor.
Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
results.description: Kettlebell Single Leg Romanian Deadlifts is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Split Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand with your arms hanging by your sides. Take a step forward with your right foot and position your left foot back, standing on the ball of your left foot.
Bend both knees to lower your body into a split squat. Your back knee should hover just above the floor, and your front thigh should be parallel to the floor.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position, fully extending both legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and perform the same number of repetitions on the other side.
tips: Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your ankle, not extending past your toes.
Keep your feet hip-width apart to maintain proper alignment and balance.
results.description: Kettlebell Split Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Kettlebell Squats
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with each hand hanging by your sides.
Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if sitting in a chair.
Continue lowering yourself until your thighs are parallel to the floor, making sure your knees track over your toes.
Push through your heels to stand back up to the starting position, fully extending your legs.
tips: Ensure your knees stay in line with your toes to prevent any inward collapse.
Inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up to standing.
Focus on pressing through your heels to activate your glutes and quadriceps.
results.description: Kettlebell Squats is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift
instructions: Stand with one foot slightly behind the other and hold a kettlebell in front of you.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at your hips to lower the bell toward the floor with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch the front leg.
tips: The back foot is only for balance.
Keep the kettlebell close to your legs.
results.description: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

results.name: Kettlebell Step Up
instructions: Stand facing a bench, holding a kettlebell in each hand with your arms hanging at your sides.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pressing through your heel to lift your body up. Bring your left foot up to meet your right foot on the bench.
Step down with your left foot first, followed by your right foot, returning to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest up and your shoulders back throughout the exercise.
Breathe in as you step down and exhale as you step up.
Ensure your whole foot is on the bench when stepping up to avoid slipping.
results.description: Kettlebell Step Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Kettlebell Bench Step Up
instructions: Stand facing a bench, holding a kettlebell in each hand with your arms hanging at your sides.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pressing through your heel to lift your body up. Bring your left foot up to meet your right foot on the bench.
Step down with your left foot first, followed by your right foot, returning to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest up and your shoulders back throughout the exercise.
Breathe in as you step down and exhale as you step up.
Ensure your whole foot is on the bench when stepping up to avoid slipping.
results.description: Kettlebell Bench Step Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Kettlebell Suitcase Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in your right hand next to your right thigh, with your arm extended. Your left arm can hang by your side or be extended in front of you for counterbalance.
Push your hips back as if sitting into a chair to lower your body into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to stand back up to the starting position, maintaining a straight back and engaged core.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch the kettlebell to your left hand and perform the exercise on the other side.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid leaning to one side.
Use a weight that allows you to maintain proper form throughout the exercise.
Ensure your knees track over your toes to prevent knee strain.
results.description: Kettlebell Suitcase Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core, Calves.

results.name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat (Version 2)
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward. Hold a kettlebell with both hands, letting it hang down between your legs.
Hinge at your hips while bending your knees to lower your body into a squat.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the floor or slightly below.
Push through your heels to rise back to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees track over your toes to prevent knee strain.
Exhale as you rise from the squat, inhale as you lower into it.
Maintain a wide stance with toes pointed slightly outward.
results.description: Kettlebell Sumo Squat (Version 2) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.

results.name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat Off Stepbox
instructions: Stand between two stepboxes with a wide stance, toes pointed slightly outward. Hold a kettlebell with both hands, letting it hang between your legs.
Lower yourself into a wide squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back. Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
Repeat the squat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not collapse inward during the squat.
Keep your back straight and chest up to avoid leaning forward.
Use a weight that challenges your strength but allows you to maintain proper form.
results.description: Kettlebell Sumo Squat Off Stepbox is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.
